sources.name: GTA Zone
sources.what: hidden / visible split of the 55 trophies

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all yours — there is nothing else to do for it. Everything is single-player, so no DLC or online trophy is required, and the road is roughly 200 hours at PowerPyx's 4/10 difficulty rating. Work through the roadmap in order and this one takes care of itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It pops as soon as the mission ends, so everyone who starts the story earns it — Exophase shows it at 99.99%, the most-earned trophy in the set.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Unmissable: complete Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it actually unlocks when you start the first mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?', so don't worry if it doesn't pop the instant Chapter 1 ends — keep playing and it lands.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Unmissable: complete Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it pops as the next chapter opens — here, when you begin Chapter 3's first mission, 'Welcome to Vice City'.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Unmissable: complete Chapter 3. PowerPyx says it lands after the first two missions of Chapter 4 ('Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'), so play on into Chapter 4 and it will pop.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Unmissable: complete Chapter 4. It unlocks with the final mission of Chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero', so it arrives at the end of the chapter's story.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Unmissable gold: complete the final mission. PowerPyx places the final mission, 'Starting From Zero', in Chapter 4 — finish the story and this gold is yours along with the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Unmissable: complete the Chapter 2 mission 'Breakfast Run'. Just play the story — it pops during that mission.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Unmissable: complete 'The Cartel Heist', a Chapter 3 story mission. It pops as the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Unmissable: complete 'Child's Play', a Chapter 4 story mission. It pops as the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Unmissable: complete 'Headliners', a Chapter 4 story mission. It pops as the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Unmissable: complete 'VCIA Takedown', a Chapter 4 story mission at Vice City International Airport. It pops as the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Unmissable: complete 'Operation Savage Glory', a Chapter 5 story mission. It pops as the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set (PowerPyx) and the whole second half of the platinum: reach 100% completion. The checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story, but progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. The requirements are forgiving — PowerPyx puts it near 60% true completion: most side quests aren't needed, you need 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests demand everything. Budget around 100 hours after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts — the 100% checklist wants 300, so this pops on the way. The four kinds are 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps; mix them freely, and PowerPyx calls under-the-bridges the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or by name on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (car, race challenge or drone race) and performing a stunt. PowerPyx says you'll do all of them naturally while chasing the other trophies, so don't grind it early — check Progress > Activities to see what's left.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx links a full locations guide; the gold medals aren't too difficult, and the ranges are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so this is stage-2 work.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations — one win per spot is enough for the trophy, though the 100% checklist wants all 42 races. PowerPyx has a locations guide for all 14 spots.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations — winning the same race twice doesn't count. PowerPyx lists all 40 race locations.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui' (where you meet Cal), he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple map icon — follow his fishing questline to the challenge and win it.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish all its levels at least once; you don't need every challenge. Three of the four games (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind) are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and the fourth (Bang For Your Buck) is on arcade machines around the world. Pick whichever you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia: while playing as Lucia you'll get a call from Andy, then a text with her address in Belville. Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All still available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1 after 'Island Dreams' — he calls, then shows as a green 'KR' icon in Key Lento. Clear 7 shipwrecks: he marks purple treasure-chest icons, you dive, dig with the metal detector and bring the treasures back. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3 (call Brian as Jason to speed it up), so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break' at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County: five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers — but only certain questlines count. PowerPyx confirms Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. All strangers are still findable after the story in free-roam; the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His 'Wish List' questline opens after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS', where you steal a Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green 'RK' icon, west Vice City) — scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the list, and deliver in good condition for more pay. Track it under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His questline opens after the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty' and is Jason-only: purple markers show synthetic labs around Vice City — destroy them in 'Take Out Kitty Litter', then Tyrone hands you the second quest, 'Spin On This', which pops the trophy. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable trophy — the only one in the set. Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, and each spot counts +2 if you meditate there with both Jason and Lucia. The catch: the very first meditation happens at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and is gone after that chapter — after the mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose 'Accept'. PowerPyx isn't sure yet whether that first meditation is required for the trophy (it isn't marked as a spot, though it raises the counter), but their author earned the trophy after doing it, so do it to be safe. The final meditation needs both characters playable together, which unlocks after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break'.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only: after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break', Jason gets a text marking 'Veteran Hunted' in Lummox County. Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' and marks hunting spots with purple icons; bring him the animals he requests. PowerPyx notes it's still unconfirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy — the 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% anyway, so this should come naturally. Track under Map > Activities > Target Deck.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of the 18 in the game. PowerPyx has a locations guide for all 18 sets — pick the three easiest to finish.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: hold Up + R1 to scan objects in the world. Any mix counts — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags, more than 100 in total. Scanning vehicles for Whip It Good uses the same app, so the two trophies progress together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way — leave it late, pick the easiest remaining ones, and track them under Progress > Challenges.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. You need Jason and Lucia together, which unlocks after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break' (call your partner with Right + Triangle). Build 4 stars, then escape: PowerPyx's easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — bank vault robberies always bring 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Available after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break'. Keep the flashing wanted level alive across three green-icon robbery targets — PowerPyx recommends the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'), looting a couple of items and the back-room safe in each. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; hit a fourth if it doesn't land.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The WAiNK app is the fast way: hold Up to open it, then R1 to scan vehicles as they pass — you don't need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops on the way. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming). It slows time for only a few seconds, so prepare: eat or drink to buff focus, use Adrenaline to extend it, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Line up 5 criminals at a gang operation and don't miss. It doesn't work on soldiers, police or civilians, and it gets easier at Focus level 4 (raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots).
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a large passenger plane docked to a boarding bridge — not one parked on the airfield. PowerPyx's easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway, take off and fly 1 km from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — the Rhinos at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base: drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' to get the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors. Use it on a store's back door (kicking triggers the alarm), find the safe code note in the back room and loot the safe. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — out of 8 large bank jobs, all 8 needed for 100%. Start with the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' (wait at the café), which teaches the loop: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and hand a bag to your partner (you can't carry it all). Afterward, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more vans. Every vault brings an instant 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easy way: the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' counts a bank-vault robbery as an armored truck robbery, so it pops automatically there. Earlier, you can block a truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door and escape the red heat radius — sticky bombs come from the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map, all 52 areas. PowerPyx's advice: do it by plane, flying over every fogged patch until the map is clear.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops on the way. Operations show as yellow icons when you go near them; track per-gang counts under Progress > Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown: 'Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.' No verified trigger exists yet as of 19 November 2026. The description points to ordering a cocktail somewhere with an Ocean Beach view; check PowerPyx's guide for updates before grinding it. This guide will not invent steps for it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. PowerPyx has the method: steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the window. You need the Key Cloner first, unlocked in Chapter 3's 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs'. Hack the car, drive forward through the glass — only this specific blue Banshee counts, a nod to GTA III, and the pop is slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley: steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a gang operation in Port Gellhorn — the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique 'Gutterball Moreland 850' shotgun in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (sticky bombs open it). You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling'; if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later, so it isn't missable. The trophy pops after you escape the police.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Have maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break' (when you can switch characters). Work out at fitness clubs — always bring your partner (Right + Triangle to call them), because while one trains, the other finishes their training too, doubling progress. You can also work out at home after the story. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and watch for the demon face: stealthy objectives and clean escapes count as Professional, non-lethal takedowns as Hardened, kills as Violent, mass killing as Psycho — and Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid going that far. It accrues passively through robberies and fights, so it should land while you work on everything else.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown: 'Second time's the charm.' Their current belief is that it's related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but no verified trigger exists yet as of 19 November 2026. This guide won't invent steps for it — check PowerPyx's guide for updates.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: PowerPyx cracked this one on 19 November: it's the UFO easter egg. Go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2 AM. If a blinking car is parked at the roadside, follow the path into the woods to find the UFO (bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and it drops an abducted woman — talk to her, offer to help, then walk back to her car at the roadside to pop the trophy. The spawn is slightly random: if the car isn't there, drive away and come back.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown: 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.' Their current belief is that it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, but no verified trigger exists yet as of 19 November 2026. This guide won't invent steps for it — check PowerPyx's guide for updates.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — a running total, not one delivery. First finish Chapter 3's 'Credit Check' to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so this lands naturally during the 100% robberies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — a running total. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest routes since they're the priciest; there are 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 67 clothing stores and more. It accrues naturally while you play.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garage properties (the 4 story garages don't count), $160,000 in total. Garages go on sale after Chapter 2's 'Daily Driver', when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the fastest way to fund them.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, installed after Chapter 2's 'Moses' mission. Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes) for parking spots, then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose 'Respray' and 'Register'. Early on he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can register Standard Tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Cheap cars and bikes keep the cost down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
